name: agent-cli
description: Workspace: Agent CLI Repo: yysun/agent-cli CLI: agent-cli Core objects: - Memory = map marks - Tension = terrain signals - Insight = route judgment - Action = next move

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build:agent-world-cli && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:syntax && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:relay && npm run web:typecheck
scripts.test:syntax: npm run build && node --check ./bin/agent-cli.js && node --check ./bin/agent-world-cli.js && node --check ./core/agent-config.js && node --check ./core/agent-files.js && node --check ./core/paths.js && node --check ./core/relay-client.js && node --check ./core/remote-control.js && node --check ./core/runtime-client.js && node --check ./core/session-store.js && node --check ./bin/server.js && node --check ./vitest.config.js && node --check ./tests/helpers/test-root.js && node --check ./tests/unit/agent-cli.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/agent-config.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/agent-files.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/paths.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/session-store.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/runtime-client.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/relay-server.test.js && node --check ./tests/unit/remote-control.test.js && node --check ./tests/e2e/agent-cli.e2e.test.js && node --check ./tests/e2e/agent-cli-remote.e2e.test.js && node --check ./tests/e2e/relay-server.e2e.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:relay && npm run test:e2e:live
scripts.test:e2e:live: npm run build && vitest run tests/e2e/agent-cli.e2e.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:relay: npm run build && npm run web:build && vitest run tests/e2e/relay-server.e2e.test.js tests/e2e/agent-cli-remote.e2e.test.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n RELAY,WEB,CLI "npm run dev:relay" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:cli"
scripts.dev:relay:lan: npm run web:build && npm run relay-server:lan --
scripts.dev:web: npm run dev:wait-relay && npm run web:dev
scripts.dev:cli: npm run build && npm run dev:wait-relay && AGENT_CLI_RELAY_SERVER_URL=${AGENT_CLI_RELAY_SERVER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8787} node ./bin/agent-cli.js --remote
scripts.relay-server:prod: npm run web:build && npm run relay-server:lan --
